events.verdict: Looney (GSW) firms up in his screening position in Barnes's (DAL) path and absorbs contact.
Smith Jr. (DAL) makes marginal contact with Durant (GSW) at the end of his drive.
Iguodala (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position on Finney-Smith (DAL)'s shot.
Finney-Smith (DAL) makes marginal contact that does not affect Iguodala's (GSW) ability to defend.
[Observable in enhanced video] Doncic (DAL) slides his pivot foot after his gather.
Jerebko (GSW) makes marginal contact with Doncic (DAL) during the shot attempt.
Barnes (DAL) has a legal forearm resting on Durant's (GSW) body during his shot attempt and does not deliver contact.
Looney (GSW) initiates some contact to Doncic (DAL) during the rebound, but does not affect his ability to get the loose ball.
Doncic (DAL) moves into Durant (GSW) and affects his drive to the basket.
Jerebko (GSW) takes a small step but does not leave the designated throw-in spot.
Barnes (DAL) makes contact to Durant's (GSW) front but does not affect his ability to drive.
Barnes (DAL) briefly has his hand on Durant's (GSW) hip as the players move in the same direction.
Barnes (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Durant (GSW)'s pull-up jump shot attempt.
Durant (GSW) commits a take foul on Finney-Smith (DAL).
Barnes (DAL) briefly grasps Durant's (GSW) arm but releases it and does not affect his movement to the rebound.
Looney (GSW) and Jordan (DAL) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Barnes (DAL) briefly places a hand on Durant's (GSW) opposite hip but removes it as the players move in the same direction.
Jerebko (GSW) takes a small step but does not leave the designated throw-in spot.
Finney-Smith (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Thompson (GSW) during his drive.
Cook (GSW) commits a take foul on Doncic (DAL).
Barnes (DAL) initiates contact to Durant (GSW) that affects his SQBR.
Thompson (GSW) and Barnes (DAL) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Jordan (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Jerebko (GSW)'s shot.
